title: Rise of ______
tagline: Choose where you begin. Build what comes next. Decide what rises.

approval.evidence: User directives in IRGS Campaign Design conversation; earlier drafted concept text.

public.setting_label: Player-configured historical, alternate, or fictional region
public.synopsis: A player-configurable household and settlement simulation rather than a fixed authored campaign. Choose the period, region, cultures, local institutions, starting household or accompanying settlers, existing rights or absence of a grant, and the name of what rises. Seek permission, establish a livelihood and home, attract households, and potentially develop an enduring community. The system generates separate persistent instances and does not require the player to begin as leader.

design.scope_statement: Reusable configuration framework creating discrete persistent campaign instances
risk_notes: New territory depicted as uninhabited by default
design.core_3_3_verification: document_reference_only; runtime capability not certified by this catalogue
design.core_integration_policy: inherit Core; propose upstream changes by CMRR; do not replicate shared resource/state owners
design.player_agency_requirement: Do not invent player speech, thoughts, motives, travel, allegiance, or voluntary decisions.
design.persistent_state_requirement: Maintain coherent records of actors, knowledge, time, possessions, ownership, transit, work, and consequences.
